description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BenchmarkBase' for benchmarking in PyTorch, including methods for instruction counting, JSON output, and logging, with conditional logging setup based on environment variables.

classes.name: BenchmarkBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for performance benchmarking in PyTorch, providing instruction counting, JSON serialization, and logging functionalities.

methods.name: with_iterations
methods.description: Sets the number of iterations for instruction counting.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Returns the category of the benchmark.

methods.name: is_dynamic
methods.description: Returns whether the benchmark is dynamic.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns a description of the benchmark.

methods.name: _prepare
methods.description: Abstract method to prepare the benchmark.

methods.name: _work
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the benchmark work.

methods.name: _prepare_once
methods.description: Method for one-time preparation, default empty.

methods.name: _count_compile_time_instructions
methods.description: Counts compile-time instructions with garbage collection disabled.

methods.name: _write_to_json
methods.description: Serializes results to JSON for benchmarking dashboard.

methods.name: append_results
methods.description: Appends results to CSV and JSON files.

methods.name: collect_all
methods.description: Performs collection of instruction counts and logs results.
